subject: maths
question: A alone can do a work in 40 days and B alone can do the same work in 60 days. In how many days will they together complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

A alone can do a work in 40 days and B alone can do the same work in 60 days.

**Formula used:**

Work done together per day = Work rate of A + Work rate of B

**Calculation:**

Work rate of A = 1/40

Work rate of B = 1/60

Work done together per day = 1/40 + 1/60

⇒ Work done together per day = dfrac{3 + 2}{120}

⇒ Work done together per day = 5/120

⇒ Work done together per day = 1/24

⇒ They will complete the work together in 24 days.

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
